description: Open the protected contact/terms/Confirm card only after company choice. Pass the explicitly chosen company's option_key from current service_options; omit it only for a single option or a previously selected company. When a live card is displayed, omit prose or use at most one short neutral sentence in the customer's language, such as: "Details and current status are in the card." Do not repeat companies, dates, times, prices, policies, booking references, status claims, comparisons or next steps outside the card. This applies only to successful card presentation; keep normal intake/choice questions and concise error or unavailable-UI guidance.

option_key.description: Exact option_key from this request's current service_options for the company explicitly chosen by the user. Never infer a choice from price or ordering.
